title: scaling_report: report a binned spatial transcriptomics scaling exponent so that two sections can be compared
description: Computes the pooled noise-resolution exponent of binned spatial transcriptomics from the mean and variance of per-bin counts, together with the per-gene distribution, the effective number of genes behind the reported number, and the range of per-gene medians that the same pooled value admits. Outputs one JSON, one Markdown report and a four-sentence reporting rule. Reproduces the colon section shipped in examples/ (gamma_pool = 0.5547, IGKC 87.7% of the exponent). Accompanies the manuscript 'Overdispersion in binned spatial transcriptomics falls 2- to 20-fold, not 16,384-fold, because the exponent is the decay rate of tissue covariance' (submitted). Python >= 3.9, numpy only.
